mike: Hey team — booking a multi-city trip (SF -> NYC -> Dublin). Can I claim per-diem across cities or do I need actual receipts for each country? Also using a personal card for some legs — any notes on conversion timing?

anya_people_ops: For multi-city trips you can choose per-diem or actuals, but you must pick one approach for the entire trip (can't mix per-diem in one country and receipts in another). If you choose per-diem, use the rate for the country where the night is spent. Example: nights in US use $60/day, nights in Ireland use $120/day. Travel days are prorated at 75%.

mike: Got it. If I paid for a Dublin hotel on my card in EUR, attach the original receipt in EUR, right?

anya_people_ops: Correct — attach the original merchant receipt in local currency. Expensify converts to USD on the report date; finance reimburses in USD. If you want reimbursement in EUR for long assignments, contact Finance.

sam_manager: Quick note on timelines — remind folks to submit within 14 days of trip end. Reimbursements usually processed 7-10 business days after manager + finance approvals.

mike: Lost a €8 tram ticket  what should I do?

anya_people_ops: For small amounts (<$20) we accept a card statement line plus a short note and manager attestation. For larger or multiple lost receipts use the Lost Receipt Affidavit in Expensify.

expense_bot: Expensify: report "SF-NYC-DUB trip - Mike" created by mike  status: needs manager approval.

mike: Thanks — will consolidate per-diem selection and upload all receipts.
